property_summary: For any admissible deposit d>0 and requested amount 0<v<=d, calling withdraw(v) succeeds and deducts exactly v wei from the contract (balance becomes d-v); the mutant always drains the entire balance, leaving 0 instead of d-v whenever d>v.
change_summary: Replace _value with address(this).balance so withdraw always transfers the contract's full balance instead of the requested amount.
